response.justification: Despite extensive full-stack and open-source experience, the candidate lacks demonstrable C++ expertise in industrial or embedded contexts, has no mention of STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, or IoT protocols critical to the role, and his recent work is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js/DLang — making him a poor fit for a C++-centric senior engineering leadership position in industrial automation.
strengths: Strong full-stack and open-source project leadership with diverse tech exposure
Proven experience in event-driven systems and distributed platforms
Active contributor to developer education and testing practices
concerns: No evidence of professional C++ or STL usage in the last 9+ years
Absence of industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), MQTT, or OPC UA experience
Primary recent stack is JavaScript/TypeScript/DLang, not C++ or embedded systems
